{"parentUuid":"dcba4d3e-efaf-4f88-aa38-1d8a6a429c95","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"f58e7cde-3c4b-4102-a368-0ab6f8b5f3aa","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_015CzuSUXTEqJtAdkPoTvkwy","type":"tool_result","content":"title:\tT01: Login, sessions, and role-gated access\nstate:\tCLOSED\nauthor:\tadamleidercollege-code\nlabels:\tticket\ncomments:\t1\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\t\nblocking:\tadamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#7, adamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#3\nnumber:\t2\n--\n## Parent\n\nPart of the spec, #1.\n\n## What to build\n\nStaff and Ambassador can log in with email + password; a wrong password is refused without revealing whether the account exists; a deactivated account can't log in; any logged-in user can log out; CSRF protection is wired for every state-changing form from here on; a reusable login-required / admin-required gate exists, proven against one stub protected route.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] A seeded Staff (admin) and Ambassador (editor) user can each log in with their email/password and reach a logged-in page.\n- [ ] A wrong password is refused with the same generic message whether or not the email exists.\n- [ ] A seeded deactivated user cannot log in, with the same generic failure message.\n- [ ] Logout ends the session; a previously-reachable logged-in page is no longer reachable afterward.\n- [ ] Every state-changing (POST) route rejects a request whose CSRF token is missing or wrong.\n- [ ] A stub admin-only route rejects an Ambassador (403) and an anonymous request (redirect to login), and allows a Staff member.\n- [ ] `scripts/seed_demo.py` seeds one admin (Staff), one editor (Ambassador), and one deactivated user, passwords from `CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD`/`CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD`/env.\n\n## Blocked by\n\nBlocked by: none\n\n---SPEC---\ntitle:\tSpec: Kenyon CGE study abroad CMS — all 7 capabilities\nstate:\tOPEN\nauthor:\tadamleidercollege-code\nlabels:\tspec\ncomments:\t0\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\t\nblocking:\t\nnumber:\t1\n--\n## Problem Statement\n\nKenyon students researching study-abroad programs currently have to rely on outside sites that are poorly maintained and hard to search for specific answers (housing, meals, social life, academics). The Kenyon Center for Global Engagement (CGE) wants its own site where student Ambassadors who've actually attended a program write about it, but CGE must review every post before it goes public — nothing unapproved can reach a reader, and an Ambassador must never be able to touch anyone else's writing or the site's structure.\n\n## Solution\n\nA CMS with two roles — **Staff** (admin) and **Ambassador** (editor), see `CONTEXT.md` — where Ambassadors write and submit Posts, Staff review and publish them, and the public site is a static export organized as Home → Continent → Country → Program, with Posts grouped and filterable by Topic on their Program page. `CONTEXT.md` and `docs/adr/ADR-003`, `ADR-004` are the settled vocabulary and decisions this spec builds on; `notes/future-work.md` lists what's deliberately deferred.\n\n## User Stories\n\n**Login (capability 1)**\n1. As a Staff member, I want to log in with my email and password, so that I can access the admin console.\n2. As an Ambassador, I want to log in with my email and password, so that I can write and manage my own posts.\n3. As any user, I want a wrong password refused without the response revealing whether the account exists, so that no one can probe for valid emails.\n4. As a deactivated user, I want my login refused, so that I can't access the system after my account is deactivated.\n5. As any logged-in user, I want to log out, so that I can end my session on a shared computer.\n\n**Roles (capability 2)**\n6. As a Staff member, I want every Ambassador capability available to me too, so that I can write and submit my own Posts without a second account.\n7. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from any admin-only route, so that I can't reach user management or page authoring.\n8. As an anonymous visitor, I want to be redirected to login when I request an admin route, so that the admin console stays private.\n\n**Posts: authoring and the review gate (capability 3, ADR-004)**\n9. As an Ambassador, I want to create a new draft Post under a Program, so that I can start writing about my experience there.\n10. As an Ambassador, I want to edit my own draft Post's title, body, and Topic, so that I can revise it before submitting.\n11. As an Ambassador, I want to delete my own draft Post, after confirming \"are you sure?\", so that I don't lose it to a misclick but can still abandon it.\n12. As an Ambassador, I want to submit my draft for review, so that CGE can decide whether to publish it.\n13. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from editing or deleting my Post once it's pending or published, so that nothing changes mid-review or after it's live without CGE knowing.\n14. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from touching another Ambassador's Post in any way, so that I can't edit, delete, or resubmit someone else's writing.\n15. As a Staff member, I want to publish a pending Post, so that it goes live on the public site.\n16. As a Staff member, I want to bounce a pending Post back to draft, so that its author can revise it before I reconsider.\n17. As a Staff member, I want to publish my own draft Post directly, so that I don't have to route my own work through a review queue.\n18. As a Staff member, I want the option to submit my own Post to pending instead, so that another Staff member can review it first.\n19. As a Staff member, I want to edit or delete any Post regardless of status or author, so that I can fix a problem or remove content without waiting on anyone.\n20. As a Staff member, I want to unpublish a live Post back to draft, so that I can pull it down for a larger rewrite.\n\n**Pages and the content tree (capability 4)**\n21. As a Staff member, I want to create a Page nested under an existing Page (Home, a Continent, or a Country), so that I can build out the Continent → Country → Program tree.\n22. As a Staff member, I want to create a standalone Page directly under Home (e.g. \"About CGE\"), so that I can publish information that isn't travel content.\n23. As a Staff member, I want to flag a Page to show in the footer, so that standalone pages are reachable without cluttering the main navigation.\n24. As a Staff member, I want to edit or delete any Page, so that I can keep the site's structure current as programs change.\n25. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from creating, editing, or deleting any Page, so that the site's structure stays under CGE's control.\n\n**Topic (ADR-004 scope note, field notes)**\n26. As a visitor reading a Program page, I want its Posts grouped by Topic, so that I can jump straight to Housing or Academics instead of scrolling through everything.\n27. As a visitor reading a Program page, I want to filter to one Topic or see everything, so that I only see what I'm looking for.\n28. As an Ambassador, I want to tag my Post with a Topic when I write it, so that it lands in the right section of the Program page.\n\n**Public navigation (field notes, client brief)**\n29. As a visitor on any public page, I want a nav bar with Home and the Continents, so that I can jump to a different region from anywhere.\n30. As a visitor drilled into a Program page, I want a breadcrumb trail (Home → Continent → Country → Program), so that I can see where I am and step back up a level at a time.\n31. As a visitor, I want a footer linking to standalone pages like \"About CGE\" and \"Contact Us\", so that I can find that information from anywhere on the site.\n32. As a visitor on a phone, I want the nav bar to wrap or collapse, so that it never runs off the screen.\n\n**Admin console (capability 5)**\n33. As a Staff member, I want my admin home screen to be a live preview of the site, so that I land on what's actually published, the way WordPress's own admin works.\n34. As a Staff member, I want a Dashboard tab with counts (Posts by status, Pages by level, active accounts), so that I can see the state of the whole site at a glance.\n35. As a Staff member, I want a Pending queue tab listing every Post waiting on a decision, so that nothing sits unreviewed because no one thought to check.\n36. As a Staff member, I want a Metrics tab showing Posts per Program, so that I can see which programs have no Ambassador content yet.\n37. As an Ambassador, I want a \"My posts\" view listing my own drafts, pending, and published Posts, so that I can track what I've written without seeing anyone else's.\n\n**User management (capability 6)**\n38. As a Staff member, I want an Accounts tab to create users, assign a role, and activate/deactivate an account, so that I can manage who has access.\n39. As a Staff member, I want a deactivated Ambassador's draft Posts deleted automatically, so that the content list doesn't fill up with abandoned half-finished student work.\n40. As a Staff member, I want a deactivated Staff colleague's drafts left in place, viewable, editable, publishable, and deletable by any other Staff member just like any other content, so that CGE's own unfinished work isn't lost just because whoever started it left.\n41. As a Staff member, I want a deactivated user's pending and published content left exactly as it is, so that I can still publish what's in the queue and readers keep seeing valuable published content.\n42. As a visitor, I want a published Post to keep showing its original author's name even after that account is deactivated, so that the byline stays honest.\n\n**Public site and publish (capability 7)**\n43. As a Staff member, I want `cms publish` to write only published Posts and Pages into `site/`, so that nothing in draft or pending ever leaks to the public.\n44. As a Staff member, I want every link and asset in the exported HTML to be relative, so that the site works on its GitHub Pages subpath.\n45. As a visitor, I want a Post's Markdown rendered as sanitized HTML, so that nothing an Ambassador wrote can inject a script into the page I'm reading.\n46. As a Staff member, I want a slug frozen the instant something is published, so that a link a reader has already shared never breaks.\n\n## Implementation Decisions\n\n**Module split** (new, per this spec): `app/models.py` — plain SQLite access (no ORM, per ADR-002), `User`/`Page`/`Post` reads and writes. `app/services/` — pure rules with no FastAPI or SQLite dependency: slug generation, the status state machine, the deactivation cascade. `app/routes/` — thin HTTP handlers that call services for decisions and models for persistence. `templates/` — unchanged, `admin/` and `public/` subtrees as already established.\n\n**Data model** (logical, fields not file-bound):\n- `User`: id, email, password_hash (argon2), role (`admin`/`editor`), display_name, active (bool), timestamps.\n- `Page`: id, parent_id (nullable only for Home), title, slug, body (Markdown), status (`draft`/`published` — **no `pending`**: only Staff author Pages, and Staff can self-publish, so there's never a reviewer to wait on), `show_in_footer` (bool), author_id, timestamps, published_at.\n- `Post`: id, program_id (must reference a Program-level Page), title, slug, body (Markdown), topic (`general`/`housing`/`meals`/`social-life`/`academics`/`other`), status (`draft`/`pending`/`published`), author_id, timestamps, published_at.\n\n**Status state machine** (services layer; a decision this precise is clearer as a table than prose):\n\n| From | Action | Who | To |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| draft | submit | the Post's own author (any role) | pending |\n| pending | publish | any admin | published |\n| pending | bounce | any admin | draft |\n| draft | self-publish | admin, **own Post only** | published |\n| published | unpublish | any admin | draft |\n\nNo other transition exists. In particular, an admin cannot move *someone else's* draft straight to published — it must be submitted to pending first, same as anyone's. This keeps \"an Ambassador's post is never published without someone deciding to put it through pending\" true even when the decider is an admin, not just an Ambassador.\n\n**Content edit/delete permission** (orthogonal to status, from `CONTEXT.md`'s Staff/Ambassador entries): admin — any Post or Page, any status, always. Editor — only their own Post, only while draft. Never any Page.\n\n**Slug generation**: derived from title (lowercase, non-alphanumeric runs collapsed to hyphens). Regenerates on every title change while status is draft; frozen the moment status leaves draft, even if an admin edits the title afterward. On a collision with a sibling under the same parent, append `-2`, `-3`, … — not grilled explicitly; flagged below.\n\n**Deactivation cascade** (services layer): the cascade is role-specific, not uniform. Deactivating an **Ambassador** deletes their draft Posts — nothing worth keeping from a student who's left. Deactivating a **Staff member** deletes nothing: their drafts (Posts or Pages) stay exactly as they are, and since admin permission is \"any Post or Page, any status, always\" (see Content edit/delete permission above), any other Staff member can already view, edit, publish, or delete them like any other content — Staff drafts are usually CGE's own ongoing work, not a departing student's. Pending and published content is left untouched regardless of which role is deactivated, byline intact.\n\n**Public URL / nav contract**: a Page's public path is the slug chain of its ancestors from Home (Home = site root); a Post's path nests under its Program's path. A footer-flagged standalone Page still gets a path under Home, just excluded from Home's own child listing (`CONTEXT.md`, Page).\n\n**Admin console layout**: Staff's landing screen is a live preview of the site inside the console; sidebar tabs are Dashboard, Pending queue, Accounts, Page hierarchy, Metrics. Ambassador's sidebar is just \"My posts\". No reviewer assignment and no notifications on the pending queue — any admin can act on any pending Post.\n\n## Testing Decisions\n\nA good test asserts externally observable behavior — status code, redirect target, response HTML, a written file's contents, or a service function's return value/raised error — never an internal implementation detail.\n\n- **HTTP seam** (`TestClient`, prior art: `tests/test_t00.py`, `conftest.py`'s `client_as(role)`): login success/failure/deactivated, every admin-only route rejected for an editor and for an anonymous request, Post/Page CRUD and every status-transition route end-to-end, CSRF rejection on a POST with the token stripped, the Dashboard/Pending-queue/Accounts/Metrics/My-posts screens, nav bar/breadcrumb/footer HTML on public pages.\n- **`render_site()` seam** (prior art: `test_publish_writes_a_site`, `test_published_html_uses_relative_paths`): a draft or pending Post/Page present but absent from the output, every href/src relative, sanitized Markdown in the exported HTML, a frozen slug surviving a post-publish title edit, nav/breadcrumb/footer present in the static files.\n- **Services seam** (new, no HTTP or DB — plain pytest functions): every cell of the status state-machine table including the disallowed combinations (e.g. editor attempting publish, admin attempting draft→published on someone else's Post), slug generation and its collision suffixing, the deactivation cascade's decision of which Posts/Pages to delete vs. keep.\n\n## Out of Scope\n\nPer ADR-003: private messaging, a visitor/commenter account role, an IT/developer role, view/comment-based search filters, in-CMS suggested-edit tooling. Per `notes/future-work.md`: trash/restore with a 30-day auto-delete (plain delete only, with a confirmation prompt), scheduled/visibility-gated publish. Per the grill (A6): sitewide/scoped search is a stretch ticket after the 7 capabilities, client-side against a JSON index built at publish time — not part of this spec's core tickets.\n\n## Further Notes\n\nThree points in this spec were synthesized (not explicitly grilled) because they follow directly from decisions already settled, and have been confirmed:\n\n1. **Pages have no `pending` status** — only `draft`/`published`, since only Staff author Pages and Staff can self-publish (ADR-004 only ever discusses Posts).\n2. **Slug collisions** get a numeric suffix (`-2`, `-3`, …), scoped to siblings sharing a parent — never explicitly asked.\n3. **An admin can't draft→published someone else's Post** — only their own; everyone else's still needs pending. ADR-004's \"into or out of published\" language is satisfied by the unpublish transition (published→draft), not by a second direct-publish shortcut.\n\nThe deactivation cascade (above) was corrected after an initial draft wrongly proposed deleting a deactivated Staff member's drafts too — it's Ambassador-only, confirmed.\n\n`scripts/seed_demo.py` will need Asia/Africa/Europe as Continents, a couple Countries under each, one or two Programs per Country, and generated placeholder copy at every level (A1) — a tickets-stage task, noted here so it isn't lost.","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"55eb05f2-1443-483a-bcea-1ef7aa6946a8","timestamp":"2026-10-06T17:40:42.615Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"title:\tT01: Login, sessions, and role-gated access\nstate:\tCLOSED\nauthor:\tadamleidercollege-code\nlabels:\tticket\ncomments:\t1\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\t\nblocking:\tadamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#7, adamleidercollege-code/iphs400-mp2-cms#3\nnumber:\t2\n--\n## Parent\n\nPart of the spec, #1.\n\n## What to build\n\nStaff and Ambassador can log in with email + password; a wrong password is refused without revealing whether the account exists; a deactivated account can't log in; any logged-in user can log out; CSRF protection is wired for every state-changing form from here on; a reusable login-required / admin-required gate exists, proven against one stub protected route.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] A seeded Staff (admin) and Ambassador (editor) user can each log in with their email/password and reach a logged-in page.\n- [ ] A wrong password is refused with the same generic message whether or not the email exists.\n- [ ] A seeded deactivated user cannot log in, with the same generic failure message.\n- [ ] Logout ends the session; a previously-reachable logged-in page is no longer reachable afterward.\n- [ ] Every state-changing (POST) route rejects a request whose CSRF token is missing or wrong.\n- [ ] A stub admin-only route rejects an Ambassador (403) and an anonymous request (redirect to login), and allows a Staff member.\n- [ ] `scripts/seed_demo.py` seeds one admin (Staff), one editor (Ambassador), and one deactivated user, passwords from `CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD`/`CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD`/env.\n\n## Blocked by\n\nBlocked by: none\n\n---SPEC---\ntitle:\tSpec: Kenyon CGE study abroad CMS — all 7 capabilities\nstate:\tOPEN\nauthor:\tadamleidercollege-code\nlabels:\tspec\ncomments:\t0\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\t\nblocking:\t\nnumber:\t1\n--\n## Problem Statement\n\nKenyon students researching study-abroad programs currently have to rely on outside sites that are poorly maintained and hard to search for specific answers (housing, meals, social life, academics). The Kenyon Center for Global Engagement (CGE) wants its own site where student Ambassadors who've actually attended a program write about it, but CGE must review every post before it goes public — nothing unapproved can reach a reader, and an Ambassador must never be able to touch anyone else's writing or the site's structure.\n\n## Solution\n\nA CMS with two roles — **Staff** (admin) and **Ambassador** (editor), see `CONTEXT.md` — where Ambassadors write and submit Posts, Staff review and publish them, and the public site is a static export organized as Home → Continent → Country → Program, with Posts grouped and filterable by Topic on their Program page. `CONTEXT.md` and `docs/adr/ADR-003`, `ADR-004` are the settled vocabulary and decisions this spec builds on; `notes/future-work.md` lists what's deliberately deferred.\n\n## User Stories\n\n**Login (capability 1)**\n1. As a Staff member, I want to log in with my email and password, so that I can access the admin console.\n2. As an Ambassador, I want to log in with my email and password, so that I can write and manage my own posts.\n3. As any user, I want a wrong password refused without the response revealing whether the account exists, so that no one can probe for valid emails.\n4. As a deactivated user, I want my login refused, so that I can't access the system after my account is deactivated.\n5. As any logged-in user, I want to log out, so that I can end my session on a shared computer.\n\n**Roles (capability 2)**\n6. As a Staff member, I want every Ambassador capability available to me too, so that I can write and submit my own Posts without a second account.\n7. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from any admin-only route, so that I can't reach user management or page authoring.\n8. As an anonymous visitor, I want to be redirected to login when I request an admin route, so that the admin console stays private.\n\n**Posts: authoring and the review gate (capability 3, ADR-004)**\n9. As an Ambassador, I want to create a new draft Post under a Program, so that I can start writing about my experience there.\n10. As an Ambassador, I want to edit my own draft Post's title, body, and Topic, so that I can revise it before submitting.\n11. As an Ambassador, I want to delete my own draft Post, after confirming \"are you sure?\", so that I don't lose it to a misclick but can still abandon it.\n12. As an Ambassador, I want to submit my draft for review, so that CGE can decide whether to publish it.\n13. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from editing or deleting my Post once it's pending or published, so that nothing changes mid-review or after it's live without CGE knowing.\n14. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from touching another Ambassador's Post in any way, so that I can't edit, delete, or resubmit someone else's writing.\n15. As a Staff member, I want to publish a pending Post, so that it goes live on the public site.\n16. As a Staff member, I want to bounce a pending Post back to draft, so that its author can revise it before I reconsider.\n17. As a Staff member, I want to publish my own draft Post directly, so that I don't have to route my own work through a review queue.\n18. As a Staff member, I want the option to submit my own Post to pending instead, so that another Staff member can review it first.\n19. As a Staff member, I want to edit or delete any Post regardless of status or author, so that I can fix a problem or remove content without waiting on anyone.\n20. As a Staff member, I want to unpublish a live Post back to draft, so that I can pull it down for a larger rewrite.\n\n**Pages and the content tree (capability 4)**\n21. As a Staff member, I want to create a Page nested under an existing Page (Home, a Continent, or a Country), so that I can build out the Continent → Country → Program tree.\n22. As a Staff member, I want to create a standalone Page directly under Home (e.g. \"About CGE\"), so that I can publish information that isn't travel content.\n23. As a Staff member, I want to flag a Page to show in the footer, so that standalone pages are reachable without cluttering the main navigation.\n24. As a Staff member, I want to edit or delete any Page, so that I can keep the site's structure current as programs change.\n25. As an Ambassador, I want to be blocked from creating, editing, or deleting any Page, so that the site's structure stays under CGE's control.\n\n**Topic (ADR-004 scope note, field notes)**\n26. As a visitor reading a Program page, I want its Posts grouped by Topic, so that I can jump straight to Housing or Academics instead of scrolling through everything.\n27. As a visitor reading a Program page, I want to filter to one Topic or see everything, so that I only see what I'm looking for.\n28. As an Ambassador, I want to tag my Post with a Topic when I write it, so that it lands in the right section of the Program page.\n\n**Public navigation (field notes, client brief)**\n29. As a visitor on any public page, I want a nav bar with Home and the Continents, so that I can jump to a different region from anywhere.\n30. As a visitor drilled into a Program page, I want a breadcrumb trail (Home → Continent → Country → Program), so that I can see where I am and step back up a level at a time.\n31. As a visitor, I want a footer linking to standalone pages like \"About CGE\" and \"Contact Us\", so that I can find that information from anywhere on the site.\n32. As a visitor on a phone, I want the nav bar to wrap or collapse, so that it never runs off the screen.\n\n**Admin console (capability 5)**\n33. As a Staff member, I want my admin home screen to be a live preview of the site, so that I land on what's actually published, the way WordPress's own admin works.\n34. As a Staff member, I want a Dashboard tab with counts (Posts by status, Pages by level, active accounts), so that I can see the state of the whole site at a glance.\n35. As a Staff member, I want a Pending queue tab listing every Post waiting on a decision, so that nothing sits unreviewed because no one thought to check.\n36. As a Staff member, I want a Metrics tab showing Posts per Program, so that I can see which programs have no Ambassador content yet.\n37. As an Ambassador, I want a \"My posts\" view listing my own drafts, pending, and published Posts, so that I can track what I've written without seeing anyone else's.\n\n**User management (capability 6)**\n38. As a Staff member, I want an Accounts tab to create users, assign a role, and activate/deactivate an account, so that I can manage who has access.\n39. As a Staff member, I want a deactivated Ambassador's draft Posts deleted automatically, so that the content list doesn't fill up with abandoned half-finished student work.\n40. As a Staff member, I want a deactivated Staff colleague's drafts left in place, viewable, editable, publishable, and deletable by any other Staff member just like any other content, so that CGE's own unfinished work isn't lost just because whoever started it left.\n41. As a Staff member, I want a deactivated user's pending and published content left exactly as it is, so that I can still publish what's in the queue and readers keep seeing valuable published content.\n42. As a visitor, I want a published Post to keep showing its original author's name even after that account is deactivated, so that the byline stays honest.\n\n**Public site and publish (capability 7)**\n43. As a Staff member, I want `cms publish` to write only published Posts and Pages into `site/`, so that nothing in draft or pending ever leaks to the public.\n44. As a Staff member, I want every link and asset in the exported HTML to be relative, so that the site works on its GitHub Pages subpath.\n45. As a visitor, I want a Post's Markdown rendered as sanitized HTML, so that nothing an Ambassador wrote can inject a script into the page I'm reading.\n46. As a Staff member, I want a slug frozen the instant something is published, so that a link a reader has already shared never breaks.\n\n## Implementation Decisions\n\n**Module split** (new, per this spec): `app/models.py` — plain SQLite access (no ORM, per ADR-002), `User`/`Page`/`Post` reads and writes. `app/services/` — pure rules with no FastAPI or SQLite dependency: slug generation, the status state machine, the deactivation cascade. `app/routes/` — thin HTTP handlers that call services for decisions and models for persistence. `templates/` — unchanged, `admin/` and `public/` subtrees as already established.\n\n**Data model** (logical, fields not file-bound):\n- `User`: id, email, password_hash (argon2), role (`admin`/`editor`), display_name, active (bool), timestamps.\n- `Page`: id, parent_id (nullable only for Home), title, slug, body (Markdown), status (`draft`/`published` — **no `pending`**: only Staff author Pages, and Staff can self-publish, so there's never a reviewer to wait on), `show_in_footer` (bool), author_id, timestamps, published_at.\n- `Post`: id, program_id (must reference a Program-level Page), title, slug, body (Markdown), topic (`general`/`housing`/`meals`/`social-life`/`academics`/`other`), status (`draft`/`pending`/`published`), author_id, timestamps, published_at.\n\n**Status state machine** (services layer; a decision this precise is clearer as a table than prose):\n\n| From | Action | Who | To |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| draft | submit | the Post's own author (any role) | pending |\n| pending | publish | any admin | published |\n| pending | bounce | any admin | draft |\n| draft | self-publish | admin, **own Post only** | published |\n| published | unpublish | any admin | draft |\n\nNo other transition exists. In particular, an admin cannot move *someone else's* draft straight to published — it must be submitted to pending first, same as anyone's. This keeps \"an Ambassador's post is never published without someone deciding to put it through pending\" true even when the decider is an admin, not just an Ambassador.\n\n**Content edit/delete permission** (orthogonal to status, from `CONTEXT.md`'s Staff/Ambassador entries): admin — any Post or Page, any status, always. Editor — only their own Post, only while draft. Never any Page.\n\n**Slug generation**: derived from title (lowercase, non-alphanumeric runs collapsed to hyphens). Regenerates on every title change while status is draft; frozen the moment status leaves draft, even if an admin edits the title afterward. On a collision with a sibling under the same parent, append `-2`, `-3`, … — not grilled explicitly; flagged below.\n\n**Deactivation cascade** (services layer): the cascade is role-specific, not uniform. Deactivating an **Ambassador** deletes their draft Posts — nothing worth keeping from a student who's left. Deactivating a **Staff member** deletes nothing: their drafts (Posts or Pages) stay exactly as they are, and since admin permission is \"any Post or Page, any status, always\" (see Content edit/delete permission above), any other Staff member can already view, edit, publish, or delete them like any other content — Staff drafts are usually CGE's own ongoing work, not a departing student's. Pending and published content is left untouched regardless of which role is deactivated, byline intact.\n\n**Public URL / nav contract**: a Page's public path is the slug chain of its ancestors from Home (Home = site root); a Post's path nests under its Program's path. A footer-flagged standalone Page still gets a path under Home, just excluded from Home's own child listing (`CONTEXT.md`, Page).\n\n**Admin console layout**: Staff's landing screen is a live preview of the site inside the console; sidebar tabs are Dashboard, Pending queue, Accounts, Page hierarchy, Metrics. Ambassador's sidebar is just \"My posts\". No reviewer assignment and no notifications on the pending queue — any admin can act on any pending Post.\n\n## Testing Decisions\n\nA good test asserts externally observable behavior — status code, redirect target, response HTML, a written file's contents, or a service function's return value/raised error — never an internal implementation detail.\n\n- **HTTP seam** (`TestClient`, prior art: `tests/test_t00.py`, `conftest.py`'s `client_as(role)`): login success/failure/deactivated, every admin-only route rejected for an editor and for an anonymous request, Post/Page CRUD and every status-transition route end-to-end, CSRF rejection on a POST with the token stripped, the Dashboard/Pending-queue/Accounts/Metrics/My-posts screens, nav bar/breadcrumb/footer HTML on public pages.\n- **`render_site()` seam** (prior art: `test_publish_writes_a_site`, `test_published_html_uses_relative_paths`): a draft or pending Post/Page present but absent from the output, every href/src relative, sanitized Markdown in the exported HTML, a frozen slug surviving a post-publish title edit, nav/breadcrumb/footer present in the static files.\n- **Services seam** (new, no HTTP or DB — plain pytest functions): every cell of the status state-machine table including the disallowed combinations (e.g. editor attempting publish, admin attempting draft→published on someone else's Post), slug generation and its collision suffixing, the deactivation cascade's decision of which Posts/Pages to delete vs. keep.\n\n## Out of Scope\n\nPer ADR-003: private messaging, a visitor/commenter account role, an IT/developer role, view/comment-based search filters, in-CMS suggested-edit tooling. Per `notes/future-work.md`: trash/restore with a 30-day auto-delete (plain delete only, with a confirmation prompt), scheduled/visibility-gated publish. Per the grill (A6): sitewide/scoped search is a stretch ticket after the 7 capabilities, client-side against a JSON index built at publish time — not part of this spec's core tickets.\n\n## Further Notes\n\nThree points in this spec were synthesized (not explicitly grilled) because they follow directly from decisions already settled, and have been confirmed:\n\n1. **Pages have no `pending` status** — only `draft`/`published`, since only Staff author Pages and Staff can self-publish (ADR-004 only ever discusses Posts).\n2. **Slug collisions** get a numeric suffix (`-2`, `-3`, …), scoped to siblings sharing a parent — never explicitly asked.\n3. **An admin can't draft→published someone else's Post** — only their own; everyone else's still needs pending. ADR-004's \"into or out of published\" language is satisfied by the unpublish transition (published→draft), not by a second direct-publish shortcut.\n\nThe deactivation cascade (above) was corrected after an initial draft wrongly proposed deleting a deactivated Staff member's drafts too — it's Ambassador-only, confirmed.\n\n`scripts/seed_demo.py` will need Asia/Africa/Europe as Continents, a couple Countries under each, one or two Programs per Country, and generated placeholder copy at every level (A1) — a tickets-stage task, noted here so it isn't lost.","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"dcba4d3e-efaf-4f88-aa38-1d8a6a429c95","session_id":"95361e77-7731-41a1-ab06-8e7db18aaa8c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"128d513b-42d5-441f-97ab-1666a2830efd","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

AND slug = ?\", (parent_id, slug)\n        ).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_page(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_all_pages() -> list[Page]:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages\").fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_page(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_ancestors(page: Page) -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Home first, down to (but not including) `page` itself.\"\"\"\n    chain: list[Page] = []\n    current = page\n    while current.parent_id is not None:\n        parent = get_page_by_id(current.parent_id)\n        chain.append(parent)\n        current = parent\n    chain.reverse()\n    return chain\n\n\ndef create_page(\n    parent_id: int, title: str, body: str, show_in_footer: bool, author_id: int\n) -> Page:\n    if get_page_by_id(parent_id) is None:\n        raise ValueError(f\"parent page {parent_id} does not exist\")\n    sibling_slugs = {c.slug for c in list_children(parent_id)}\n    slug = slugs.dedupe(slugs.slugify(title), sibling_slugs)\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO pages (parent_id, title, slug, body, status, show_in_footer, \"\n            \"author_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'draft', ?, ?)\",\n            (parent_id, title, slug, body, int(show_in_footer), author_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(cur.lastrowid)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef update_page(page_id: int, title: str, body: str, show_in_footer: bool) -> Page:\n    page = get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    if page is None:\n        raise ValueError(f\"page {page_id} does not exist\")\n    if page.status == \"draft\":\n        sibling_slugs = {\n            c.slug for c in list_children(page.parent_id) if c.id != page.id\n        }\n        slug = slugs.dedupe(slugs.slugify(title), sibling_slugs)\n    else:\n        slug = page.slug  # frozen the moment status leaves draft\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE pages SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?, show_in_footer = ?, \"\n            \"updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?\",\n            (title, slug, body, int(show_in_footer), page_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef publish_page(page_id: int) -> Page:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE pages SET status = 'published', \"\n            \"published_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), \"\n            \"updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?\",\n            (page_id,),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef delete_page(page_id: int) -> None:\n    page = get_page_by_id(page_id)\n    if page is not None and page.parent_id is None:\n        raise ValueError(\"cannot delete the Home page\")\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM pages WHERE id = ?\", (page_id,))\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\nTOPIC_CHOICES = [\n    (\"general\", \"General\"),\n    (\"housing\", \"Housing\"),\n    (\"meals\", \"Meals\"),\n    (\"social-life\", \"Social Life\"),\n    (\"academics\", \"Academics\"),\n    (\"other\", \"Other\"),\n]\nTOPIC_VALUES = {value for value, _label in TOPIC_CHOICES}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Post:\n    id: int\n    program_id: int\n    title: str\n    slug: str\n    body: str\n    topic: str\n    status: str\n    author_id: int | None\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n\n\ndef _row_to_post(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Post:\n    return Post(\n        id=row[\"id\"],\n        program_id=row[\"program_id\"],\n        title=row[\"title\"],\n        slug=row[\"slug\"],\n        body=row[\"body\"],\n        topic=row[\"topic\"],\n        status=row[\"status\"],\n        author_id=row[\"author_id\"],\n        created_at=row[\"created_at\"],\n        updated_at=row[\"updated_at\"],\n        published_at=row[\"published_at\"],\n    )\n\n\ndef get_post_by_id(post_id: FROM posts WHERE program_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC\",\n            (program_id,),\n        ).fetchall()\n        return [_row_to_post(r) for r in rows]\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_published_posts_by_program(program_id: int) -> list[Post]:\n    \"\"\"Public-facing: only published Posts, most recent first. AND slug = ? AND status = 'published'\",\n            (program_id, slug),\n        ).fetchone()\n        return _row_to_post(row) if row else None\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef group_posts_by_topic(posts: list[Post]) -> list[tuple[str, str, list[Post]]]:\n    \"\"\"Posts in Topic order (CONTEXT.md: General first, then each Hot Topic),\n    skipping any Topic with nothing to show.\"\"\"\n    buckets: dict[str, list[Post]] = {value: [] for value, _label in TOPIC_CHOICES}\n    for post in posts:\n        buckets[post.topic].append(post)\n    return [\n        (value, label, buckets[value])\n        for value, label in TOPIC_CHOICES\n        if buckets[value]\n    ]\n\n\ndef is_program_page(page: Page) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"A Program is the Page three levels below Home is_program_page(program):\n        raise ValueError(f\"page {program_id} is not a Program-level page\")\n    if topic not in TOPIC_VALUES:\n        raise ValueError(f\"invalid topic: {topic!r}\")\n conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO posts (program_id, title, slug, body, topic, author_id) \"\n            \"VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (program_id, title, slug, body, topic, Post:\n    post = get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise ValueError(f\"post {post_id} does not exist\")\n    if topic not in TOPIC_VALUES:\n        raise ValueError(f\"invalid topic: {topic!r}\")\n    if post.status == \"draft\":\n        sibling_slugs = {\n            p.slug for p in list_posts_by_program(post.program_id) if p.id != post.id\n        }\n        slug = slugs.dedupe(slugs.slugify(title), sibling_slugs)\n    else:\n        slug = post.slug  # frozen the moment status leaves draft\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE posts SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?, topic = ?, \"\n            \"updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?\",\n            (title, slug, body, topic, post_id),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\nclass StatusConflict(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by set_post_status when the Post's status no longer matches\n    `from_status` — another request changed it between the caller's read and\n    this write, e.g. one admin bounced a pending Post the instant another\n    admin published it. The caller re-reads and re-authorizes rather than\n    overwriting a decision it never actually validated.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef set_post_status(post_id: int, from_status: str, to_status: str) -> Post:\n    \"\"\"Apply a review-gate transition (app.services.review_gate.transition\n    decides `to_status`; this is the one place that writes it), guarded by\n    `WHERE status = from_status` so a stale read can never clobber a status\n    change made in between. published_at is set on entry to 'published' and\n    cleared on any exit from it, so it never lingers on a Post that isn't\n    currently live.\n    \"\"\"\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        published_at_sql = (\n            \"published_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), \"\n            if to_status == \"published\" else \"published_at = NULL, \"\n        )\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE posts SET status = ?, \" + published_at_sql +\n            \"updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') \"\n            \"WHERE id = ? AND status = ?\",\n            (to_status, post_id, from_status),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        if cur.rowcount == 0:\n            raise StatusConflict(\n                f\"post {post_id} is no longer {from_status!r}; refresh and retry\"\n            )\n        return get_post_by_id(post_id)\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef delete_post(post_id: int) -> None:\n    conn = db.get_connection()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM posts WHERE id = ?\", (post_id,))\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n","numLines":496,"startLine":1,"totalLines":496}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d161a9e6-1f28-4b15-8f6e-9bf3323d020e","session_id":"95361e77-7731-41a1-ab06-8e7db18aaa8c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"128d513b-42d5-441f-97ab-1666a2830efd","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"694efd73-603f-41db-9dd5-b4b177653bf6","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"f58e7cde-3c4b-4102-a368-0ab6f8b5f3aa","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01JUTvKWbz9vqwsNvbDVfq66","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t#!/usr/bin/env python3\n2\t\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n3\t\n4\t    uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\n5\t\n6\tT00 has nothing to seed. As you build content types, extend this so it creates:\n7\t  - one admin and one editor (passwords read from .env, never hard-coded)\n8\t  - a few posts and pages, at least one draft and one published\n9\t\n10\tThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n11\t(item E4), because the database itself is never committed.\n12\t\"\"\"\n13\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n14\t\n15\timport os\n16\timport sys\n17\t\n18\tsys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))\n19\t\n20\tfrom app import db, models  # noqa: E402\n21\t\n22\t# Continent -> Country -> [Program, ...], per T02's seed requirement.\n23\tCONTINENTS = {\n24\t    \"Asia\": {\n25\t        \"Japan\": [\"Kyoto Exchange\"],\n26\t        \"South Korea\": [\"Seoul Studies\"],\n27\t    },\n28\t    \"Africa\": {\n29\t        \"Kenya\": [\"Nairobi Fieldwork\"],\n30\t        \"South Africa\": [\"Cape Town Semester\"],\n31\t    },\n32\t    \"Europe\": {\n33\t        \"Spain\": [\"Madrid Language Immersion\"],\n34\t        \"France\": [\"Paris Arts & Culture\"],\n35\t    },\n36\t}\n37\tSTANDALONE_PAGES = [\"About CGE\", \"Contact Us\"]\n38\t\n39\t# Cycled across the seeded Programs so posts land across different Topics\n40\t# (T03 acceptance: \"a few draft Posts across different Topics\").\n41\tPOST_TOPICS = [\"housing\", \"meals\", \"social-life\", \"academics\", \"other\", \"general\"]\n42\t\n43\t# Cycled too, so the review-gate workflow (ADR-004) is visible on a fresh\n44\t# clone (T04 acceptance): at least one Post in each status.\n45\tPOST_STATUSES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\n46\t\n47\t\n48\tdef _placeholder_body(title: str) -> str:\n49\t    return (\n50\t        f\"Placeholder copy for **{title}**. Replace this with real content \"\n51\t        \"once CGE has something to say here.\"\n52\t    )\n53\t\n54\t\n55\tdef _seed_pages(admin_id: int) -> list[models.Page]:\n56\t    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n57\t    if models.list_children(home.id):\n58\t        print(\"Pages already seeded, leaving the tree as-is.\")\n59\t        return [\n60\t            program\n61\t            for continent in models.list_children(home.id)\n62\t            for country in models.list_children(continent.id)\n63\t            for program in models.list_children(country.id)\n64\t As you build content types, extend this so it creates:\n  - one admin and one editor (passwords read from .env, never hard-coded)\n  - a few posts and pages, at least one draft and one published\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))\n\nfrom app import db, models  # noqa: E402\n\n# Continent -> Country -> [Program, ...], per T02's seed requirement.\nCONTINENTS = {\n    \"Asia\": {\n        \"Japan\": [\"Kyoto Exchange\"],\n        \"South Korea\": [\"Seoul Studies\"],\n    },\n    \"Africa\": {\n        \"Kenya\": [\"Nairobi Fieldwork\"],\n        \"South Africa\": [\"Cape Town Semester\"],\n    },\n    \"Europe\": {\n        \"Spain\": [\"Madrid Language Immersion\"],\n        \"France\": [\"Paris Arts & Culture\"],\n    },\n}\nSTANDALONE_PAGES = [\"About CGE\", \"Contact Us\"]\n\n# Cycled across the seeded Programs so posts land across different Topics\n# (T03 acceptance: \"a few draft Posts across different Topics\").\nPOST_TOPICS = [\"housing\", \"meals\", \"social-life\", \"academics\", \"other\", \"general\"]\n\n# Cycled too, so the review-gate workflow (ADR-004) is visible on a fresh\n# clone (T04 acceptance): at least one Post in each status.\nPOST_STATUSES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\n\n\ndef _placeholder_body(title: str) -> str:\n    return (\n        f\"Placeholder copy for **{title}**. Replace this with real content \"\n        \"once CGE has something to say here.\"\n    )\n\n\ndef _seed_pages(admin_id: int) -> list[models.Page]:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    if models.list_children(home.id):\n        print(\"Pages already seeded, leaving the tree as-is.\")\n        return [\n            program\n            for continent in models.list_children(home.id)\n            for country in models.list_children(continent.id)\n            for program in models.list_children(country.id)\n        ]\n\n    def _add(parent_id: int, title: str, show_in_footer: bool = False) -> models.Page:\n        page = models.create_page(\n            parent_id=parent_id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            show_in_footer=show_in_footer, author_id=admin_id,\n        )\n        return models.publish_page(page.id)\n\n    programs: list[models.Page] = []\n    for continent_title, countries in CONTINENTS.items():\n        continent = _add(home.id, continent_title)\n        for country_title, program_titles in countries.items():\n            country = _add(continent.id, country_title)\n            for program_title in program_titles:\n                programs.append(_add(country.id, program_title))\n\n    for standalone_title in STANDALONE_PAGES:\n        _add(home.id, standalone_title, show_in_footer=True)\n\n    print(\"Seeded the Continent -> Country -> Program tree and standalone pages.\")\n    return programs\n\n\ndef _seed_posts(programs: list[models.Page], editor_id: int) -> None:\n    if not programs or any(models.list_posts_by_program(p.id) for p in programs):\n        print(\"Posts already seeded (or no programs to seed under), leaving as-is.\")\n        return\n\n    for i, program in enumerate(programs):\n        topic = POST_TOPICS[i % len(POST_TOPICS)]\n        status = POST_STATUSES[i % len(POST_STATUSES)]\n        title = f\"My first week at {program.title}\"\n        post = models.create_post(\n            program_id=program.id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            topic=topic, author_id=editor_id,\n        )\n        if status in (\"pending\", \"published\"):\n            models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n        if status == \"published\":\n            models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"pending\", to_status=\"published\")\n    print(f\"Seeded {len(programs)} posts across Topics and statuses \"\n          \"(draft/pending/published) under the seeded Programs.\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    admin_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\")\n    editor_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\")\n    deactivated_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_DEACTIVATED_PASSWORD\", \"change-me-deactivated\")\n    if not admin_pw or not editor_pw:\n        print(\"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD in .env \"\n              \"(copy .env.example).\")\n        return 1\n\n    db.init_db()\n    for email, pw, role, name, active in [\n        (\"admin@example.test\", admin_pw, \"admin\", \"Staff Demo\", True),\n        (\"editor@example.test\", editor_pw, \"editor\", \"Ambassador Demo\", True),\n        (\"deactivated@example.test\", deactivated_pw, \"editor\", \"Deactivated Demo\", False),\n    ]:\n        if models.get_user_by_email(email) is None:\n            models.create_user(email=email, password=pw, role=role,\n                                display_name=name, active=active)\n    print(\"Seeded admin, editor, and deactivated demo users.\")\n\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = _seed_pages(admin.id)\n Every cell of the spec's status/action table, including the\n3\tdisallowed ones, lives here so app/routes/posts.py only has to call\n4\t`transition()` and turn a ValueError into a 403.\n5\t\n6\t| From      | Action    | Who                        | To        |\n7\t|-----------|-----------|-----------------------------|-----------|\n8\t| draft     | submit    | the Post's own author       | pending   |\n9\t| pending   | publish   | any admin                   | published |\n10\t| pending   | bounce    | any admin                   | draft     |\n11\t| draft     | publish   | admin, own Post only        | published |\n12\t| published | unpublish | any admin                   | draft     |\n13\t\n14\tNo other (status, action) pair exists.\n15\t\"\"\"\n16\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n17\t\n18\tfrom typing import Callable\n19\t\n20\t_Rule = Callable[[str, bool], bool]\n21\t\n22\t_RULES: dict[tuple[str, str], _Rule] = {\n23\t    (\"draft\", \"submit\"): lambda role, is_author: is_author,\n24\t    (\"draft\", \"publish\"): lambda role, is_author: role == \"admin\" and is_author,\n25\t    (\"pending\", \"publish\"): lambda role, is_author: role == \"admin\",\n26\t    (\"pending\", \"bounce\"): lambda role, is_author: role == \"admin\",\n27\t    (\"published\", \"unpublish\"): lambda role, is_author: role == \"admin\",\n28\t}\n29\t\n30\t_TARGETS: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {\n31\t    (\"draft\", \"submit\"): \"pending\",\n32\t    (\"draft\", \"publish\"): \"published\",\n33\t    (\"pending\", \"publish\"): \"published\",\n34\t    (\"pending\", \"bounce\"): \"draft\",\n35\t    (\"published\", \"unpublish\"): \"draft\",\n36\t}\n37\t\n38\tACTION_LABELS = {\n39\t    \"submit\": \"Submit for review\",\n40\t    \"publish\": \"Publish\",\n41\t    \"bounce\": \"Bounce to draft\",\n42\t    \"unpublish\": \"Unpublish\",\n43\t}\n44\t\n45\t\n46\tdef transition(status: str, action: str, role: str, is_author: bool) -> str:\n47\t    \"\"\"Return the Post's new status.\n48\t\n49\t    Raises ValueError if `action` isn't allowed from `status` for this\n50\t    role/authorship combination — including an admin trying to take someone\n51\t    else's draft straight to published, which must pass through pending\n52\t    first same as anyone's.\n53\t    \"\"\"\n54\t    key = (status, action)\n55\t    rule = _RULES.get(key)\n56\t    if rule is None or not rule(role, is_author):\n57\t        raise ValueError(\n58\t            f\"{action!r} is not allowed on a {status!r} post \"\n59\t            f\"(role={role!r}, is_author={is_author!r})\"\n60\t        )\n61\t    return _TARGETS[key]\n62\t\n63\t\n64\tdef available_actions(status: str, role: str, is_author: bool) -> list[str]:\n65\t    \"\"\"Actions this role/authorship combination may currently take from\n66\t    `status` — used to decide which buttons to render in the Posts list.\"\"\"\n67\t    return [\n68\t        action\n69\t        for (st, action), rule in _RULES.items()\n70\t        if st == status and rule(role, is_author)\n71\t    ]\n72\t"}]},"uuid":"897860a8-a72e-47d9-b116-494708df525e","timestamp":"2026-10-06T17:40:56.257Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/services/review_gate.py","content":"\"\"\"The Action    | Who                        | To        |\n|-----------|-----------|-----------------------------|-----------|\n| draft     | submit    | the Post's own author       | pending   |\n| pending   | publish   | any admin                   | published |\n| pending   | bounce    | any admin                   | draft     |\n| draft     | publish   | admin, own Post only        | published |\n| published | unpublish | any admin                   | draft     |\n\nNo other (status, action) pair exists.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Callable\n\n_Rule = Callable[[str, bool], bool]\n\n_RULES: dict[tuple[str, str], _Rule] = {\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\"): lambda role, is_author: is_author,\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\"): lambda role, is_author: role == \"admin\" and is_author,\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\"): lambda role, is_author: role == \"admin\",\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\"): lambda role, is_author: role == \"admin\",\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\"): lambda role, is_author: role == \"admin\",\n}\n\n_TARGETS: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\"): \"pending\",\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\"): \"published\",\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\"): \"published\",\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\"): \"draft\",\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\"): \"draft\",\n}\n\nACTION_LABELS = {\n    \"submit\": \"Submit for review\",\n    \"publish\": \"Publish\",\n    \"bounce\": \"Bounce to draft\",\n    \"unpublish\": \"Unpublish\",\n}\n\n\ndef transition(status: str, action: str, role: str, is_author: bool) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Return the Post's new status.\n\n    Raises ValueError if `action` isn't allowed from `status` for this\n    role/authorship combination — including an admin trying to take someone\n    else's draft straight to published, which must pass through pending\n    first same as anyone's.\n    \"\"\"\n    key = (status, action)\n    rule = _RULES.get(key)\n    if rule is None or not rule(role, is_author):\n        raise ValueError(\n            f\"{action!r} is not allowed on a {status!r} post \"\n            f\"(role={role!r}, is_author={is_author!r})\"\n        )\n    return _TARGETS[key]\n\n\ndef available_actions(status: str, role: str, is_author: bool) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Actions this role/authorship combination may currently take from\n    `status` — used to decide which buttons to render in the Posts list.\"\"\"\n    return [\n        action\n        for (st, action), rule in _RULES.items()\n        if st == status and rule(role, is_author)\n    ]\n","numLines":72,"startLine":1,"totalLines":72}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"faa61ffa-c011-4306-b72e-a92302f4e4b0","session_id":"95361e77-7731-41a1-ab06-8e7db18aaa8c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"128d513b-42d5-441f-97ab-1666a2830efd","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

Posts — the review-gate state machine (ADR-004).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom app.services import review_gate\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\nSTATUSES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\nACTIONS = [\"submit\", \"publish\", \"bounce\", \"unpublish\"]\n\n# Every (status, action, role, is_author) -> expected target status, or None\n# if the transition must be rejected. This is every cell of the spec's table,\n# including every disallowed combination.\nCASES: list[tuple[str, str, str, bool, str | None]] = [\n    # draft --submit--> pending: the Post's own author, any role.\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"editor\", True, \"pending\"),\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"admin\", True, \"pending\"),\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"editor\", False, None),  # another Ambassador's draft\n    (\"draft\", \"submit\", \"admin\", False, None),  # admin isn't the author\n    # draft --publish (self-publish)--> published: admin, own Post only.\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"admin\", True, \"published\"),\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"admin\", False, None),  # someone else's draft\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"editor\", True, None),  # editor can never publish\n    (\"draft\", \"publish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # pending --publish--> published: any admin, regardless of author.\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"admin\", True, \"published\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"admin\", False, \"published\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"publish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # pending --bounce--> draft: any admin, regardless of author.\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", True, \"draft\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", False, \"draft\"),\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"bounce\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # published --unpublish--> draft: any admin, regardless of author.\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", True, \"draft\"),\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", False, \"draft\"),\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"published\", \"unpublish\", \"editor\", False, None),\n    # No other (status, action) pair exists at all.\n    (\"draft\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", True, None),\n    (\"draft\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"submit\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"pending\", \"unpublish\", \"admin\", True, None),\n    (\"published\", \"submit\", \"editor\", True, None),\n    (\"published\", \"bounce\", \"admin\", True, None),\n]\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"status,action,role,is_author,expected\", CASES)\ndef test_transition_table(status, action, role, is_author, expected):\n    if expected is None:\n        with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n            review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author)\n    else:\n        assert review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author) == expected\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"status\", STATUSES)\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"is_author\", [True, False])\ndef test_available_actions_matches_transition_table(status, role, is_author):\n    \"\"\"available_actions() must agree with transition() for every action,\n    not just the ones CASES happens to spell out disallowed combos for.\"\"\"\n    allowed = review_gate.available_actions(status, role, is_author)\n    for action in ACTIONS:\n        try:\n            expected_target = review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author)\n        except ValueError:\n            assert action not in allowed\n        else:\n            assert action in allowed\n            # available_actions must not have side effects or disagree on the target.\n            assert review_gate.transition(status, action, role, is_author) == expected_target\n\n\n# --- HTTP seam: the routes wire the above into the Posts admin screens -----\n\n\ndef _load_seed_demo():\n    \"\"\"scripts/ isn't a package (see tests/test_usage_report.py for prior art).\"\"\"\n    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n        \"seed_demo\", _ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"seed_demo.py\"\n    )\n    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n    spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n    return module\n\n\ndef _seed_program(parent_author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n    return models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, parent_author_id)\n\n\ndef _create_draft_post(c, program_id: int, title: str = \"My First Week\") -> models.Post:\n    page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts/new?program_id={program_id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    c.post(\n        \"/admin/posts/new\",\n        data={\"program_id\": str(program_id), \"title\": title, \"body\": \"Hello\",\n              \"topic\": \"housing\", \"action\": \"save\", \"csrf_token\": token},\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    return models.list_posts_by_program(program_id)[0]\n\n\ndef test_ambassador_submits_own_draft_then_loses_edit_access(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_draft_post(c, program.id)\n\n    list_page = c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(list_page.text)\n    response = c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/submit\",\n                       data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"pending\"\n\n    # Locked out of editing now that it's pending.\n    assert c.get(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/edit\").status_code == 403\n\n\ndef _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    editor_c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post = _create_draft_post(editor_c, program.id)\n    token = models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"pending\"\n\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    response = admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/bounce\",\n                             data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"draft\"\n\n    # Resubmit, then publish this time.\n    token = _csrf_token_from(editor_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    editor_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/submit\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    token = _csrf_token_from(admin_c.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    response = admin_c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/publish\",\n                             data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"published\"\n\n\ndef test_staff_self_publishes_own_draft_directly(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = _create_draft_post(admin_c, program.id)\n\n    token = token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"published\"\n\n\ndef test_staff_unpublishes_a_live_post(client_as):\n token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"draft\"\n\n\ndef test_ambassador_rejected_for_any_transition_other_than_submitting_own_draft(client_as):\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n\n    owner = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post = _create_draft_post(owner, program.id)\n\n    other = models.create_user(\n        email=\"other-editor@example.test\", password=\"test-other-pw\",\n        role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Other Ambassador\",\n    )\n    intruder = client_as(\"editor\")\n    login_page = intruder.get(\"/login\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(login_page.text)\n    intruder.post(\"/login\", data={\"email\": other.email, \"password\": \"test-other-pw\",\n                                   \"csrf_token\": token})\n\n    token = _csrf_token_from(owner.get(f\"/admin/posts?program_id={program.id}\").text)\n    assert intruder.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/submit\",\n                          data={\"csrf_token\": intruder.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/bounce\",\n                          data={\"csrf_token\": token}).status_code == 403\n    assert intruder.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post.id}/unpublish\",\n                          data={\"csrf_token\": token}).status_code == 403\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(post.id).status == \"draft\"\n\n\ndef test_set_post_status_rejects_a_stale_from_status(client_as):\n {"parentUuid":"a0b17c73-694a-4f48-9098-1dd6eed6c722","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"f58e7cde-3c4b-4102-a368-0ab6f8b5f3aa","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_015XqPRvv24yPpUwA4PEaQie","type":"tool_result","content":"{% extends \"public/base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <article class=\"post\">\n    <p class=\"post-topic-badge\">{{ topic_label }}</p>\n    <h1>{{ post.title }}</h1>\n    <p class=\"post-meta\">By {{ author_name }} &middot; {{ published_date }}</p>\n    {{ body_html | safe }}\n    <p><a href=\"{{ program_href }}\">&larr; Back to {{ program_title }}</a></p>\n  </article>\n{% endblock %}\n---\n\"\"\"Turn published Posts into template-ready summaries, grouped by Topic.\n\nShared by app/publish.py (static export) and app/routes/public.py (live\npreview) so the two keep rendering the same grouping, byline, and date for\nthe same data — same reason they already share app/models.py's queries and\napp/services/markdown.render.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Callable\n\nfrom app import models\n\nTOPIC_LABELS = dict(models.TOPIC_CHOICES)\n\n\ndef _author_name(post: models.Post) -> str:\n    user = models.get_user_by_id(post.author_id) if post.author_id else None\n    return user.display_name if user is not None else \"CGE Staff\"\n\n\ndef _published_date(post: models.Post) -> str:\n    stamp = post.published_at or post.created_at or \"\"\n    return stamp[:10]\n\n\ndef post_summary(post: models.Post, href: str) -> dict:\n    return {\n        \"post\": post,\n        \"href\": href,\n        \"title\": post.title,\n        \"topic_label\": TOPIC_LABELS[post.topic],\n        \"author_name\": _author_name(post),\n        \"published_date\": _published_date(post),\n    }\n\n\ndef grouped_post_summaries(\n    posts: list[models.Post], href_for: Callable[[models.Post], str]\n) -> list[tuple[str, str, list[dict]]]:\n    \"\"\"-> [(topic_value, topic_label, [post_summary, ...]), ...], Topics with\n    no published Posts omitted.\"\"\"\n    groups = models.group_posts_by_topic(posts)\n    return [\n        (value, label, [post_summary(post, href_for(post)) for post in group_posts])\n        for value, label, group_posts in groups\n    ]\n---\n\"\"\"The public site, served live from the database.\n\nThis is the admin console's \"preview\" the Pages ticket asks for: Staff see a\npublished change here immediately, before anyone runs `cms publish`. It and\nthe static exporter (app/publish.py) share the same page-tree queries in\napp/models.py and the same Markdown renderer, so the two stay in sync.\n\nOnly PUBLISHED pages are reachable here — same rule as the static export.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.publish import CSS\nfrom app.services import markdown, post_view\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ndef resolve(path: str) -> tuple[str, models.Page] | tuple[str, models.Post, models.Page] | None:\n    \"\"\"A Page by its full path, or — one segment further, under a Program —\n    a published Post by slug. Returns None on no match.\"\"\"\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    segments = [s for s in path.strip(\"/\").split(\"/\") if s]\n    current = home\n    for i, segment in enumerate(segments):\n        child = models.get_child_by_slug(current.id, segment)\n        if child is not None:\n            current = child\n            continue\n        if i == len(segments) - 1 and models.is_program_page(current):\n            post = models.get_published_post_by_slug(current.id, segment)\n            if post is not None:\n                return \"post\", post, current\n        return None\n    return \"page\", current\n\n\ndef _path_for(page: models.Page, home: models.Page) -> str:\n    if page.id == home.id:\n        return \"/\"\n    chain = [p.slug for p in models.list_ancestors(page) if p.id != home.id]\n    chain.append(page.slug)\n    return \"/\" + \"/\".join(chain) + \"/\"\n\n\ndef page_context(page: models.Page) -> dict:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continents = models.list_published_children(home.id)\n    footer_pages = models.list_footer_pages()\n    ancestors = [a for a in models.list_ancestors(page) if a.id != page.id]\n    children = models.list_published_children(page.id)\n\n    post_groups = None\n    if models.is_program_page(page):\n        page_href = _path_for(page, home)\n        posts = models.list_published_posts_by_program(page.id)\n        post_groups = post_view.grouped_post_summaries(\n            posts, lambda post: page_href.rstrip(\"/\") + f\"/{post.slug}/\"\n        )\n\n    return {\n        \"page\": page,\n        \"body_html\": markdown.render(page.body),\n        \"nav\": [{\"title\": home.title, \"href\": \"/\"}] + [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _path_for(c, home)} for c in continents\n        ],\n        \"breadcrumb\": [{\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _path_for(a, home)} for a in ancestors]\n        + [{\"title\": page.title, \"href\": _path_for(page, home)}],\n        \"footer_links\": [\n            {\"title\": f.title, \"href\": _path_for(f, home)} for f in footer_pages\n        ],\n        \"children\": [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _path_for(c, home)} for c in children\n        ],\n        \"post_groups\": post_groups,\n    }\n\n\ndef post_context(post: models.Post, program: models.Page) -> dict:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continents = models.list_published_children(home.id)\n    footer_pages = models.list_footer_pages()\n    ancestors = [a for a in models.list_ancestors(program) if a.id != program.id]\n    program_href = _path_for(program, home)\n    post_href = program_href.rstrip(\"/\") + f\"/{post.slug}/\"\n    summary = post_view.post_summary(post, post_href)\n\n    return {\n        \"post\": post,\n        \"body_html\": markdown.render(post.body),\n        \"topic_label\": summary[\"topic_label\"],\n        \"author_name\": summary[\"author_name\"],\n        \"published_date\": summary[\"published_date\"],\n        \"program_href\": program_href,\n        \"program_title\": program.title,\n        \"nav\": [{\"title\": home.title, \"href\": \"/\"}] + [\n            {\"title\": c.title, \"href\": _path_for(c, home)} for c in continents\n        ],\n        \"breadcrumb\": [{\"title\": a.title, \"href\": _path_for(a, home)} for a in ancestors]\n        + [{\"title\": program.title, \"href\": program_href},\n           {\"title\": post.title, \"href\": post_href}],\n        \"footer_links\": [\n            {\"title\": f.title, \"href\": _path_for(f, home)} for f in footer_pages\n        ],\n    }\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{path:path}\")\ndef public_page(request: Request, path: str):\n    resolved = resolve(path)\n    if resolved is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n\n    if resolved[0] == \"post\":\n        _kind, post, program = resolved\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/post.html\",\n            {\"title\": post.title, \"inline_css\": CSS, **post_context(post, program)},\n        )\n\n    _kind, page = resolved\n    if page.status != \"published\":\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"public/page.html\",\n        {\"title\": page.title, \"inline_css\": CSS, **page_context(page)},\n result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, require_admin, verify_csrf\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/accounts\")\n\nROLE_CHOICES = [(\"admin\", \"Staff\"), (\"editor\", \"Ambassador\")]\nROLE_VALUES = {value for value, _label in ROLE_CHOICES}\n\n\ndef _get_user_or_404(user_id: int) -> models.User:\n    user = models.get_user_by_id(user_id)\n    if user is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such user\")\n    return user\n\n\ndef _render_new_form(\n    request: Request, error: str | None, email: str, display_name: str, role: str,\n    status_code: int = 200,\n):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/accounts_form.html\",\n        {\n            \"title\": \"New account\",\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n            \"roles\": ROLE_CHOICES,\n            \"form_email\": email,\n            \"form_display_name\": display_name,\n            \"form_role\": role,\n        },\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_accounts(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/accounts_list.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Accounts\", \"users\": models.list_users(), \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_account_form(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    return _render_new_form(request, error=None, email=\"\", display_name=\"\", role=\"editor\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_account(\n    request: Request,\n    email: str = Form(\"\"),\n    display_name: str = Form(\"\"),\n    password: str = Form(\"\"),\n    role: str = Form(\"editor\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    if role not in ROLE_VALUES:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Invalid role\")\n    if not email.strip() or not display_name.strip() or not password:\n        return _render_new_form(\n            request, error=\"Email, display name, and password are all required.\",\n            email=email, display_name=display_name, role=role, status_code=400,\n        )\n    try:\n        models.create_user(\n            email=email, password=password, role=role, display_name=display_name,\n        )\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        return _render_new_form(\n            request, error=\"An account with status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{user_id}/deactivate\")\nasync def deactivate_account(\n    user_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    _get_user_or_404(user_id)\n    models.deactivate_user(user_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/accounts\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{user_id}/reactivate\")\nasync def reactivate_account(\n    user_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    _get_user_or_404(user_id)\n    models.reactivate_user(user_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/accounts\",
