That is the whole skeleton — it exists so you can prove the stack\nruns before you build anything on it.\n\nAdd your routes in their own modules (app/routes/posts.py and so on) and include\nthem here. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, models, settings\nfrom app.routes import auth, pages, posts, public\nfrom app.routes.auth import (\n    AdminRequired,\n    CsrfInvalid,\n    LoginRequired,\n    ensure_csrf_token,\n    get_current_user,\n)\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    db.init_db()\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                        session_cookie=\"cms_session\")\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def _login_required(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(url=\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(AdminRequired)\n    def _admin_required(request: Request, exc: AdminRequired):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden\", status_code=403)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(CsrfInvalid)\n    def _csrf_invalid(request: Request, exc: CsrfInvalid):\n        return PlainTextResponse(\"Forbidden: missing or invalid CSRF token\", status_code=403)\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(pages.router)\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\n\n    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request, user: models.User | None = Depends(get_current_user)):\n        csrf_token = ensure_csrf_token(request) if user else None\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"user\": user, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token},\n        )\n\n    # Catch-all last: the live public site, read straight from the database —\n    # the admin console's \"preview\" of what `cms publish` will later export.\n    app.include_router(public.router)\n\n    # User management and the deactivation cascade.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom app.services import deactivation\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\n# --- Services seam: pure, no HTTP or DB -------------------------------------\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"role,expected\", [(\"editor\", True), (\"admin\", False)]\n)\ndef test_should_delete_drafts_is_role_specific(role, expected):\n    assert deactivation.should_delete_drafts(role) is expected\n\n\n# --- Models seam: the cascade itself ----------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _seed_program(author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, author_id)\n    return models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, author_id)\n\n\ndef test_deactivating_an_ambassador_deletes_their_draft_posts(client):\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    ambassador = models.create_user(\n        email=\"leaving-student@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Leaving Student\",\n    )\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    draft = models.create_post(program.id, \"My Draft\", \"body\", \"housing\", ambassador.id)\n\n    models.deactivate_user(ambassador.id)\n\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(draft.id) is None\n    assert models.get_user_by_id(ambassador.id).active is False\n\n\ndef test_deactivating_a_staff_member_leaves_their_drafts_untouched(client):\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    leaving_staff = models.create_user(\n        email=\"leaving-staff@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=\"admin\", display_name=\"Leaving Staff\",\n    )\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    draft = models.create_post(program.id, \"Ongoing Work\", \"body\", \"housing\", leaving_staff.id)\n\n    models.deactivate_user(leaving_staff.id)\n\n    kept = models.get_post_by_id(draft.id)\n    assert kept is not None\n    assert kept.status == \"draft\"\n    assert models.get_user_by_id(leaving_staff.id).active is False\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"editor\", \"admin\"])\ndef test_deactivation_leaves_pending_and_published_posts_alone(client, role):\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    author = models.create_user(\n        email=f\"author-{role}@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=role, display_name=\"Author\", active=True,\n    )\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    pending = models.create_post(program.id, \"Pending Post\", \"body\", \"housing\", author.id)\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n    published = models.create_post(program.id, \"Published Post\", \"body\", \"housing\", author.id)\n    models.set_post_status(published.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n    models.set_post_status(published.id, from_status=\"pending\", to_status=\"published\")\n\n    models.deactivate_user(author.id)\n\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(pending.id).status == \"pending\"\n    published_after = models.get_post_by_id(published.id)\n    assert published_after.status == \"published\"\n    assert published_after.author_id == author.id\n\n\ndef test_reactivate_user_restores_active_flag(client):\n    ambassador = models.create_user(\n        email=\"back-again@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Back Again\",\n    )\n    models.deactivate_user(ambassador.id)\n    assert models.get_user_by_id(ambassador.id).active is False\n\n    models.reactivate_user(ambassador.id)\n    assert models.get_user_by_id(ambassador.id).active is True\n\n\n# --- HTTP seam ---------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_staff_creates_a_user_and_assigns_a_role(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = admin_c.get(\"/admin/accounts/new\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    response = admin_c.post(\n        \"/admin/accounts/new\",\n        data={\n            \"email\": \"new-ambassador@example.test\",\n            \"display_name\": \"New Ambassador\",\n            \"password\": \"a-fine-password\",\n            \"role\": \"editor\",\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n        },\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    created = models.get_user_by_email(\"new-ambassador@example.test\")\n    assert created is not None\n    assert created.role == \"editor\"\n    assert created.active is True\n\n\ndef test_staff_deactivates_and_reactivates_a_user(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    target = models.create_user(\n        email=\"toggle@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Toggle Me\",\n    )\n    list_page = admin_c.get(\"/admin/accounts\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(list_page.text)\n    response = admin_c.post(\n        f\"/admin/accounts/{target.id}/deactivate\",\n        data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_user_by_id(target.id).active is False\n\n    list_page = admin_c.get(\"/admin/accounts\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(list_page.text)\n    response = admin_c.post(\n        f\"/admin/accounts/{target.id}/reactivate\",\n        data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_user_by_id(target.id).active is True\n\n\ndef test_ambassador_is_blocked_from_every_accounts_route(client_as):\n    editor_c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    target = models.create_user(\n        email=\"victim@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Victim\",\n    )\n    assert editor_c.get(\"/admin/accounts\").status_code == 403\n    assert editor_c.get(\"/admin/accounts/new\").status_code == 403\n    assert editor_c.post(\"/admin/accounts/new\", data={}).status_code == 403\n    assert editor_c.post(f\"/admin/accounts/{target.id}/deactivate\",\n                          data={}).status_code == 403\n    assert editor_c.post(f\"/admin/accounts/{target.id}/reactivate\",\n                          data={}).status_code == 403\n\n\ndef test_anonymous_request_is_redirected_to_login(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/admin/accounts\", follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n\n\ndef test_published_post_keeps_its_byline_after_author_deactivated(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    ambassador = models.create_user(\n        email=\"byline-author@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Byline Author\",\n    )\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = models.create_post(program.id, \"A Great Post\", \"body\", \"housing\", ambassador.id)\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"pending\", to_status=\"published\")\n\n    models.deactivate_user(ambassador.id)\n\n    path = f\"/{program.title.lower()}\"  # not used; resolve via public route instead\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    chain = [p.slug for p in models.list_ancestors(program) if p.id != home.id]\n    chain.append(program.slug)\n    chain.append(post.slug)\n    url = \"/\" + \"/\".join(chain) + \"/\"\n    response = admin_c.get(url)\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Byline Author\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_duplicate_email_is_rejected_with_a_friendly_error(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = admin_c.get(\"/admin/accounts/new\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    response = admin_c.post(\n        \"/admin/accounts/new\",\n        data={\n            \"email\": \"admin@example.test\",  # already seeded\n            \"display_name\": \"Duplicate\",\n            \"password\": \"whatever\",\n            \"role\": \"admin\",\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n        },\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"already exists\" in response.text\n\n\n# --- scripts/seed_demo.py ----------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _load_seed_demo():\n    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\n        \"seed_demo\", _ROOT / \"scripts\" / \"seed_demo.py\"\n    )\n    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n    spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n    return module\n\n\ndef test_seed_demo_seeds_deactivated_users_showing_the_cascade(client):\n    seed_demo = _load_seed_demo()\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = seed_demo._seed_pages(admin.id)\n    seed_demo._seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n    seed_demo._seed_deactivated_users_with_drafts(programs)\n\n    deactivated_ambassador = models.get_user_by_email(\"deactivated-ambassador@example.test\")\n    assert deactivated_ambassador is not None\n    assert deactivated_ambassador.active is False\n    assert models.list_posts_by_author(deactivated_ambassador.id) == []\n\n    deactivated_staff = models.get_user_by_email(\"deactivated-staff@example.test\")\n    assert deactivated_staff is not None\n    assert deactivated_staff.active is False\n    staff_posts = annotations\n\nimport importlib.util\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import models\nfrom app.services import deactivation\nfrom tests.conftest import _csrf_token_from\n\n_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\n# --- Services seam: pure, no HTTP or DB -------------------------------------\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"role,expected\", [(\"editor\", True), (\"admin\", False)]\n)\ndef test_should_delete_drafts_is_role_specific(role, expected):\n    assert deactivation.should_delete_drafts(role) is expected\n\n\n# --- Models seam: the cascade itself ----------------------------------------\n\n\ndef _seed_program(author_id: int) -> models.Page:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    continent = models.create_page(home.id, \"Asia\", \"\", False, author_id)\n    country = models.create_page(continent.id, \"Japan\", \"\", False, author_id)\n    return models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, author_id)\n\n\ndef test_deactivating_an_ambassador_deletes_their_draft_posts(client):\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    ambassador = models.create_user(\n        email=\"leaving-student@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Leaving Student\",\n    )\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    draft = models.create_post(program.id, \"My Draft\", \"body\", \"housing\", ambassador.id)\n\n    models.deactivate_user(ambassador.id)\n\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(draft.id) is None\n    assert models.get_user_by_id(ambassador.id).active is False\n\n\ndef test_deactivating_a_staff_member_leaves_their_drafts_untouched(client):\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    leaving_staff = models.create_user(\n        email=\"leaving-staff@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=\"admin\", display_name=\"Leaving Staff\",\n    )\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    draft = models.create_post(program.id, \"Ongoing Work\", \"body\", \"housing\", leaving_staff.id)\n\n    models.deactivate_user(leaving_staff.id)\n\n    kept = models.get_post_by_id(draft.id)\n    assert kept is not None\n    assert kept.status == \"draft\"\n    assert models.get_user_by_id(leaving_staff.id).active is False\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"editor\", \"admin\"])\ndef test_deactivation_leaves_pending_and_published_posts_alone(client, role):\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    author = models.create_user(\n        email=f\"author-{role}@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=role, display_name=\"Author\", active=True,\n    )\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    pending = models.create_post(program.id, \"Pending Post\", \"body\", \"housing\", author.id)\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n    published = models.create_post(program.id, \"Published Post\", \"body\", \"housing\", author.id)\n    models.set_post_status(published.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n    models.set_post_status(published.id, from_status=\"pending\", to_status=\"published\")\n\n    models.deactivate_user(author.id)\n\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(pending.id).status == \"pending\"\n    published_after = models.get_post_by_id(published.id)\n    assert published_after.status == \"published\"\n    assert published_after.author_id == author.id\n\n\ndef test_reactivate_user_restores_active_flag(client):\n    ambassador = models.create_user(\n        email=\"back-again@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Back Again\",\n    )\n    models.deactivate_user(ambassador.id)\n    assert models.get_user_by_id(ambassador.id).active is False\n\n    models.reactivate_user(ambassador.id)\n    assert models.get_user_by_id(ambassador.id).active is True\n\n\n# --- HTTP seam ---------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef test_staff_creates_a_user_and_assigns_a_role(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = admin_c.get(\"/admin/accounts/new\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    response = admin_c.post(\n        \"/admin/accounts/new\",\n        data={\n            \"email\": \"new-ambassador@example.test\",\n            \"display_name\": \"New Ambassador\",\n            \"password\": \"a-fine-password\",\n            \"role\": \"editor\",\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n        },\n        follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    created = models.get_user_by_email(\"new-ambassador@example.test\")\n    assert created is not None\n    assert created.role == \"editor\"\n    assert created.active is True\n\n\ndef test_staff_deactivates_and_reactivates_a_user(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    target = models.create_user(\n        email=\"toggle@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Toggle Me\",\n    )\n    list_page = admin_c.get(\"/admin/accounts\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(list_page.text)\n    response = admin_c.post(\n        f\"/admin/accounts/{target.id}/deactivate\",\n        data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_user_by_id(target.id).active is False\n\n    list_page = admin_c.get(\"/admin/accounts\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(list_page.text)\n    response = admin_c.post(\n        f\"/admin/accounts/{target.id}/reactivate\",\n        data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_user_by_id(target.id).active is True\n\n\ndef test_ambassador_is_blocked_from_every_accounts_route(client_as):\n    editor_c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    target = models.create_user(\n        email=\"victim@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Victim\",\n    )\n    assert editor_c.get(\"/admin/accounts\").status_code == 403\n    assert editor_c.get(\"/admin/accounts/new\").status_code == 403\n    assert editor_c.post(\"/admin/accounts/new\", data={}).status_code == 403\n    assert editor_c.post(f\"/admin/accounts/{target.id}/deactivate\",\n                          data={}).status_code == 403\n    assert editor_c.post(f\"/admin/accounts/{target.id}/reactivate\",\n                          data={}).status_code == 403\n\n\ndef test_anonymous_request_is_redirected_to_login(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/admin/accounts\", follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n\n\ndef test_published_post_keeps_its_byline_after_author_deactivated(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    ambassador = models.create_user(\n        email=\"byline-author@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Byline Author\",\n    )\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    post = models.create_post(program.id, \"A Great Post\", \"body\", \"housing\", ambassador.id)\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n    models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"pending\", to_status=\"published\")\n\n    models.deactivate_user(ambassador.id)\n\n    path = f\"/{program.title.lower()}\"  # not used; resolve via public route instead\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    chain = [p.slug for p in models.list_ancestors(program) if p.id != home.id]\n    chain.append(program.slug)\n    chain.append(post.slug)\n    url = \"/\" + \"/\".join(chain) + \"/\"\n    response = admin_c.get(url)\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Byline Author\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_duplicate_email_is_rejected_with_a_friendly_error(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = admin_c.get(\"/admin/accounts/new\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(page.text)\n    response = admin_c.post(\n        \"/admin/accounts/new\",\n        data={\n            \"email\": \"admin@example.test\",  # already seeded\n            \"display_name\": \"Duplicate\",\n            \"password\": \"whatever\",\n            \"role\": \"admin\",\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n        },\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"already exists\" in response.text\n\n\n# --- scripts/seed_demo.py ----------------------------------------------------\n\n\ndef spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n    return module\n\n\ndef test_seed_demo_seeds_deactivated_users_showing_the_cascade(client):\n    seed_demo = _load_seed_demo()\n    admin = The\n    Ambassador's draft is deleted by the cascade; the Staff member's is left\n    in place, same as any other Staff member's unfinished work.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not programs:\n        print(\"No programs to seed deactivated-user drafts under, leaving as-is.\")\n        return\n    if models.get_user_by_email(\"deactivated-ambassador@example.test\") is not None:\n        print(\"Deactivated demo users already seeded, leaving as-is.\")\n        return\n\n    program = programs[0]\n    ambassador = models.create_user(\n        email=\"deactivated-ambassador@example.test\", password=\"change-me-deactivated\",\n        role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Former Ambassador\",\n    )\n    models.create_post(\n        program_id=program.id, title=\"Half-finished post\", body=_placeholder_body(\"it\"),\n        topic=\"general\", author_id=ambassador.id,\n    )\n    models.deactivate_user(ambassador.id)\n\n    staff = models.create_user(\n        email=\"deactivated-staff@example.test\", password=\"change-me-deactivated\",\n        role=\"admin\", display_name=\"Former Staff\",\n    )\n    models.create_post(\n        program_id=program.id, title=\"CGE's unfinished draft\", body=_placeholder_body(\"it\"),\n        topic=\"general\", author_id=staff.id,\n    )\n    models.deactivate_user(staff.id)\n\n    print(\"Seeded a deactivated Ambassador (draft deleted by the cascade) and \"\n          \"a deactivated Staff member (draft left in place).\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n\n    uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nT00 has nothing to seed. As you build content types, extend this so it creates:\n  - one admin and one editor (passwords read from .env, never hard-coded)\n  - a few posts and pages, at least one draft and one published\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))\n\nfrom app import db, models  # noqa: E402\n\n# Continent -> Country -> [Program, ...], per T02's seed requirement.\nCONTINENTS = {\n    \"Asia\": {\n        \"Japan\": [\"Kyoto Exchange\"],\n        \"South Korea\": [\"Seoul Studies\"],\n    },\n    \"Africa\": {\n        \"Kenya\": [\"Nairobi Fieldwork\"],\n        \"South Africa\": [\"Cape Town Semester\"],\n    },\n    \"Europe\": {\n        \"Spain\": [\"Madrid Language Immersion\"],\n        \"France\": [\"Paris Arts & Culture\"],\n    },\n}\nSTANDALONE_PAGES = [\"About CGE\", \"Contact Us\"]\n\n# Cycled across the seeded Programs so posts land across different Topics\n# (T03 acceptance: \"a few draft Posts across different Topics\").\nPOST_TOPICS = [\"housing\", \"meals\", \"social-life\", \"academics\", \"other\", \"general\"]\n\n# Cycled too, so the review-gate workflow (ADR-004) is visible on a fresh\n# clone (T04 acceptance): at least one Post in each status.\nPOST_STATUSES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\n\n\ndef _placeholder_body(title: str) -> str:\n    return (\n        f\"Placeholder copy for **{title}**. Replace this with real content \"\n        \"once CGE has something to say here.\"\n    )\n\n\ndef _seed_pages(admin_id: int) -> list[models.Page]:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    if models.list_children(home.id):\n        print(\"Pages already seeded, leaving the tree as-is.\")\n        return [\n            program\n            for continent in models.list_children(home.id)\n            for country in models.list_children(continent.id)\n            for program in models.list_children(country.id)\n        ]\n\n    def _add(parent_id: int, title: str, show_in_footer: bool = False) -> models.Page:\n        page = models.create_page(\n            parent_id=parent_id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            show_in_footer=show_in_footer, author_id=admin_id,\n        )\n        return models.publish_page(page.id)\n\n    programs: list[models.Page] = []\n    for continent_title, countries in CONTINENTS.items():\n        continent = _add(home.id, continent_title)\n        for country_title, program_titles in countries.items():\n            country = _add(continent.id, country_title)\n            for program_title in program_titles:\n                programs.append(_add(country.id, program_title))\n\n    for standalone_title in STANDALONE_PAGES:\n        _add(home.id, standalone_title, show_in_footer=True)\n\n    print(\"Seeded the Continent -> Country -> Program tree and standalone pages.\")\n    return programs\n\n\ndef _seed_posts(programs: list[models.Page], editor_id: int) -> None:\n    if not programs or any(models.list_posts_by_program(p.id) for p in programs):\n        print(\"Posts already seeded (or no programs to seed under), leaving as-is.\")\n        return\n\n    for i, program in enumerate(programs):\n        topic = POST_TOPICS[i % len(POST_TOPICS)]\n        status = POST_STATUSES[i % len(POST_STATUSES)]\n        title = f\"My first week at {program.title}\"\n        post = models.create_post(\n            program_id=program.id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            topic=topic, author_id=editor_id,\n        )\n        if status in (\"pending\", \"published\"):\n            models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n        if status == \"published\":\n            models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"pending\", to_status=\"published\")\n    print(f\"Seeded {len(programs)} posts across Topics and statuses \"\n          \"(draft/pending/published) under the seeded Programs.\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    admin_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\")\n    editor_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\")\n    deactivated_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_DEACTIVATED_PASSWORD\", \"change-me-deactivated\")\n    if not admin_pw or not editor_pw:\n        print(\"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD in .env \"\n              \"(copy .env.example).\")\n        return 1\n\n    db.init_db()\n    for email, pw, role, name, active in [\n        (\"admin@example.test\", admin_pw, \"admin\", \"Staff Demo\", True),\n        (\"editor@example.test\", editor_pw, \"editor\", \"Ambassador Demo\", True),\n        (\"deactivated@example.test\", deactivated_pw, \"editor\", \"Deactivated Demo\", False),\n    ]:\n        if models.get_user_by_email(email) is None:\n            models.create_user(email=email, password=pw, role=role,\n                                display_name=name, active=active)\n    print(\"Seeded admin, editor, and deactivated demo users.\")\n\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = _seed_pages(admin.id)\n    _seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":106,"oldLines":6,"newStart":106,"newLines":46,"lines":[" (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"6bf16b1d-fd45-47cd-8b84-27f51a8f39a7","timestamp":"2026-10-06T17:43:49.889Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/scripts/seed_demo.py","oldString":"    programs = _seed_pages(admin.id)\n    _seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n    return 0","newString":"    programs = _seed_pages(admin.id)\n    _seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n    _seed_deactivated_users_with_drafts(programs)\n    return 0","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n\n    uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nT00 has nothing to seed. As you build content types, extend this so it creates:\n  - one admin and one editor (passwords read from .env, never hard-coded)\n  - a few posts and pages, at least one draft and one published\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))\n\nfrom app import db, models  # noqa: E402\n\n# Continent -> Country -> [Program, ...], per T02's seed requirement.\nCONTINENTS = {\n    \"Asia\": {\n        \"Japan\": [\"Kyoto Exchange\"],\n        \"South Korea\": [\"Seoul Studies\"],\n    },\n    \"Africa\": {\n        \"Kenya\": [\"Nairobi Fieldwork\"],\n        \"South Africa\": [\"Cape Town Semester\"],\n    },\n    \"Europe\": {\n        \"Spain\": [\"Madrid Language Immersion\"],\n        \"France\": [\"Paris Arts & Culture\"],\n    },\n}\nSTANDALONE_PAGES = [\"About CGE\", \"Contact Us\"]\n\n# Cycled across the seeded Programs so posts land across different Topics\n# (T03 acceptance: \"a few draft Posts across different Topics\").\nPOST_TOPICS = [\"housing\", \"meals\", \"social-life\", \"academics\", \"other\", \"general\"]\n\n# Cycled too, so the review-gate workflow (ADR-004) is visible on a fresh\n# clone (T04 acceptance): at least one Post in each status.\nPOST_STATUSES = [\"draft\", \"pending\", \"published\"]\n\n\ndef _placeholder_body(title: str) -> str:\n    return (\n        f\"Placeholder copy for **{title}**. Replace this with real content \"\n        \"once CGE has something to say here.\"\n    )\n\n\ndef _seed_pages(admin_id: int) -> list[models.Page]:\n    home = models.ensure_home_page()\n    if models.list_children(home.id):\n        print(\"Pages already seeded, leaving the tree as-is.\")\n        return [\n            program\n            for continent in models.list_children(home.id)\n            for country in models.list_children(continent.id)\n            for program in models.list_children(country.id)\n        ]\n\n    def _add(parent_id: int, title: str, show_in_footer: bool = False) -> models.Page:\n        page = models.create_page(\n            parent_id=parent_id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            show_in_footer=show_in_footer, author_id=admin_id,\n        )\n        return models.publish_page(page.id)\n\n    programs: list[models.Page] = []\n    for continent_title, countries in CONTINENTS.items():\n        continent = _add(home.id, continent_title)\n        for country_title, program_titles in countries.items():\n            country = _add(continent.id, country_title)\n            for program_title in program_titles:\n                programs.append(_add(country.id, program_title))\n\n    for standalone_title in STANDALONE_PAGES:\n        _add(home.id, standalone_title, show_in_footer=True)\n\n    print(\"Seeded the Continent -> Country -> Program tree and standalone pages.\")\n    return programs\n\n\ndef _seed_posts(programs: list[models.Page], editor_id: int) -> None:\n    if not programs or any(models.list_posts_by_program(p.id) for p in programs):\n        print(\"Posts already seeded (or no programs to seed under), leaving as-is.\")\n        return\n\n    for i, program in enumerate(programs):\n        topic = POST_TOPICS[i % len(POST_TOPICS)]\n        status = POST_STATUSES[i % len(POST_STATUSES)]\n        title = f\"My first week at {program.title}\"\n        post = models.create_post(\n            program_id=program.id, title=title, body=_placeholder_body(title),\n            topic=topic, author_id=editor_id,\n        )\n        if status in (\"pending\", \"published\"):\n            models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n        if status == \"published\":\n            models.set_post_status(post.id, from_status=\"pending\", to_status=\"published\")\n    print(f\"Seeded {len(programs)} posts across Topics and statuses \"\n          \"(draft/pending/published) under the seeded Programs.\")\n\n\ndef _seed_deactivated_users_with_drafts(programs: list[models.Page]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"T06 acceptance: one already-deactivated Ambassador and one\n    already-deactivated Staff member, each seeded by creating the account\n    active, giving them a draft Post, and then deactivating them — so the\n    cascade actually runs rather than just hard-coding the end state. The\n    Ambassador's draft is deleted by the cascade; the Staff member's is left\n    in place, same as any other Staff member's unfinished work.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not programs:\n        print(\"No programs to seed deactivated-user drafts under, leaving as-is.\")\n        return\n    if models.get_user_by_email(\"deactivated-ambassador@example.test\") is not None:\n        print(\"Deactivated demo users already seeded, leaving as-is.\")\n        return\n\n    program = programs[0]\n    ambassador = models.create_user(\n        email=\"deactivated-ambassador@example.test\", password=\"change-me-deactivated\",\n        role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Former Ambassador\",\n    )\n    models.create_post(\n        program_id=program.id, title=\"Half-finished post\", body=_placeholder_body(\"it\"),\n        topic=\"general\", author_id=ambassador.id,\n    )\n    models.deactivate_user(ambassador.id)\n\n    staff = models.create_user(\n        email=\"deactivated-staff@example.test\", password=\"change-me-deactivated\",\n        role=\"admin\", display_name=\"Former Staff\",\n    )\n    models.create_post(\n        program_id=program.id, title=\"CGE's unfinished draft\", body=_placeholder_body(\"it\"),\n        topic=\"general\", author_id=staff.id,\n    )\n    models.deactivate_user(staff.id)\n\n    print(\"Seeded a deactivated Ambassador (draft deleted by the cascade) and \"\n          \"a deactivated Staff member (draft left in place).\")\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    admin_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\")\n    editor_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\")\n    deactivated_pw = os.environ.get(\"CMS_DEACTIVATED_PASSWORD\", \"change-me-deactivated\")\n    if not admin_pw or not editor_pw:\n        print(\"Set CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD in .env \"\n              \"(copy .env.example).\")\n        return 1\n\n    db.init_db()\n    for email, pw, role, name, active in [\n        (\"admin@example.test\", admin_pw, \"admin\", \"Staff Demo\", True),\n        (\"editor@example.test\", editor_pw, \"editor\", \"Ambassador Demo\", True),\n        (\"deactivated@example.test\", deactivated_pw, \"editor\", \"Deactivated Demo\", False),\n    ]:\n        if models.get_user_by_email(email) is None:\n            models.create_user(email=email, password=pw, role=role,\n                                display_name=name, active=active)\n    print(\"Seeded admin, editor, and deactivated demo users.\")\n\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")\n    programs = _seed_pages(admin.id)\n    _seed_posts(programs, editor.id)\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":170,"oldLines":6,"newStart":170,"newLines":7,"lines":["     editor = models.get_user_by_email(\"editor@example.test\")","     programs = _seed_pages(admin.id)","     _seed_posts(programs, editor.id)","+    _seed_deactivated_users_with_drafts(programs)","     return 0"," "," Reactivation does not try to restore deleted drafts (there's nothing to restore — deletion is cascade-permanent by design) — just flips active back to true.\n4. The user can send it another message and resume it, so the same task-id may notify more than once.</note>\n<result>All imports used (`HTTPException` used in `_get_user_or_404`). `delete_post` is a plain hard delete with no cascading concerns (posts have no children rows referenced elsewhere in this schema, consistent with prior T04/T05 usage).\n\nI have enough to finalize. Summary of review below.\n\n## Review findings — T06 (issue #7)\n\nNo blocking issues found. Everything I checked lines up with the spec and this repo's standards.\n\n**Verified correct:**\n- `app/services/deactivation.py`: pure function, `should_delete_drafts(role)` returns `True` only for `\"editor\"` — matches the spec table exactly (Ambassador drafts deleted, Staff drafts untouched).\n- `models.deactivate_user` (`app/models.py:94-107`) only deletes posts where `post.status == \"draft\"` and only when `should_delete_drafts` is true — pending/published posts (and their `author_id` byline) are left alone for both roles. Confirmed in `test_deactivation_leaves_pending_and_published_posts_alone` and the byline test, both of which assert real post-cascade state rather than tautologies.\n- `reactivate_user` only flips `active` back to `1` via `_set_user_active` — no attempt to restore deleted drafts, matching \"cascade-permanent by design.\"\n- `app/routes/accounts.py` gates every route (`list_accounts`, `new_account_form`, `create_account`, `deactivate_account`, `reactivate_account`) with `Depends(require_admin)`, the identical pattern used in `app/routes/pages.py`. Every POST route also depends on `verify_csrf`, and GET forms call `ensure_csrf_token`. `test_ambassador_is_blocked_from_every_accounts_route` and `test_anonymous_request_is_redirected_to_login` back this up.\n- Email collision: `create_account` catches `sqlite3.IntegrityError` and re-renders the form with a 400 and a friendly message — never a 500. Password is passed straight to `passwords.hash_password` (argon2), never logged.\n- Templates (`accounts_list.html`, `accounts_form.html`) use only relative `action`/`href` values (`accounts/new`, `accounts/{id}/deactivate`, `new`) — no `href=\"/\"` or `src=\"/\"`. These resolve correctly against the un-trailing-slashed `/admin/accounts` and `/admin/accounts/new` URLs, consistent with the existing `pages_*.html` convention.\n- `scripts/seed_demo.py`'s `_seed_deactivated_users_with_drafts` creates each user active, gives them a real draft post, then calls `models.deactivate_user(...)` — it drives the actual cascade rather than hardcoding end state, satisfying the ticket's explicit acceptance criterion. Covered by `test_seed_demo_seeds_deactivated_users_showing_the_cascade`.\n- `tests/test_t06.py` assertions check externally observable behavior (DB state, HTTP status/redirect, rendered HTML containing the byline) — not tautological.\n\n**Minor, non-blocking observations (not worth a fix-up commit on their own):**\n- `models.deactivate_user` calls `list_posts_by_author` (one query) then calls `delete_post` once per matching draft (N queries). Fine at this project's scale; would be a single `DELETE ... WHERE author_id = ? AND status = 'draft'` if this ever needed to scale.\n- Neither `accounts.py` nor `models.deactivate_user` special-cases an admin deactivating their own account — a Staff member can deactivate themselves (their session would still work until logout since `active` isn't re-checked mid-session apart from `get_current_user`, which does check `user.active`, so their very next request would redirect to login).   conn.close()\n\n\ndef deactivate_user(user_id: int) -> User:\n    \"\"\"Mark the user inactive, applying the role-specific cascade\n    (app.services.deactivation): an Ambassador's draft Posts are deleted; a\n    Staff member's drafts are left exactly as they are. Pending and\n    published Posts are left untouched either way, byline intact.\n    \"\"\"\n    user = get_user_by_id(user_id)\n    if user is None:\n        raise ValueError(f\"user {user_id} does not exist\")\n    if deactivation.should_delete_drafts(user.role):\n        for post in list_posts_by_author(user_id):\n            if post.status == \"draft\":\n                delete_post(post.id)\n    return _set_user_active(user_id, False)","numLines":55,"startLine":60,"totalLines":552}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c5aa99f0-0e69-423a-a2d5-700abe21119d","session_id":"95361e77-7731-41a1-ab06-8e7db18aaa8c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/adam_leider/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"128d513b-42d5-441f-97ab-1666a2830efd","version":"2.1.272","gitBranch":"main"}

redirected to /login).\n\nDeactivation applies the role-specific cascade from\napp.services.deactivation via models.deactivate_user; this module just\nresolves the user and persists the result.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import models, settings\nfrom app.routes.auth import ensure_csrf_token, require_admin, verify_csrf\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/accounts\")\n\nROLE_CHOICES = [(\"admin\", \"Staff\"), (\"editor\", \"Ambassador\")]\nROLE_VALUES = {value for value, _label in ROLE_CHOICES}\n\n\ndef _get_user_or_404(user_id: int) -> models.User:\n    user = models.get_user_by_id(user_id)\n    if user is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such user\")\n    return user\n\n\ndef _render_new_form(\n    request: Request, error: str | None, email: str, display_name: str, role: str,\n    status_code: int = 200,\n):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/accounts_form.html\",\n        {\n            \"title\": \"New account\",\n            \"csrf_token\": token,\n            \"error\": error,\n            \"roles\": ROLE_CHOICES,\n            \"form_email\": email,\n            \"form_display_name\": display_name,\n            \"form_role\": role,\n        },\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_accounts(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    token = ensure_csrf_token(request)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/accounts_list.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Accounts\", \"users\": models.list_users(), \"csrf_token\": token},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\")\ndef new_account_form(request: Request, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin)):\n    return _render_new_form(request, error=None, email=\"\", display_name=\"\", role=\"editor\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/new\")\nasync def create_account(\n    request: Request,\n    email: str = Form(\"\"),\n    display_name: str = Form(\"\"),\n    password: str = Form(\"\"),\n    role: str = Form(\"editor\"),\n    user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    if role not in ROLE_VALUES:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"Invalid role\")\n    if not email.strip() or not display_name.strip() or not password:\n        return _render_new_form(\n            request, error=\"Email, display name, and password are all required.\",\n            email=email, display_name=display_name, role=role, status_code=400,\n        )\n    try:\n        models.create_user(\n            email=email, password=password, role=role, display_name=display_name,\n        )\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        return _render_new_form(\n            request, error=\"An account with that email already exists.\",\n            email=email, display_name=display_name, role=role, status_code=400,\n        )\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/accounts\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{user_id}/deactivate\")\nasync def deactivate_account(\n    user_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    _get_user_or_404(user_id)\n    models.deactivate_user(user_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/accounts\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{user_id}/reactivate\")\nasync def reactivate_account(\n    user_id: int, user: models.User = Depends(require_admin),\n    _csrf: None = Depends(verify_csrf),\n):\n    _get_user_or_404(user_id)\n    models.reactivate_user(user_id)\n    return RedirectResponse(url=\"/admin/accounts\", email=f\"author-{role}@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=role, display_name=\"Author\", active=True,\n    )\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    pending =   published_after = models.get_post_by_id(published.id)\n    assert published_after.status == \"published\"\n    assert published_after.author_id == author.id\n\n\ndef False, author_id)\n    return models.create_page(country.id, \"Kyoto Exchange\", \"\", False, author_id)\n\n\ndef test_deactivating_an_ambassador_deletes_their_draft_posts(client):\n    admin = models.deactivate_user(ambassador.id)\n\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(draft.id) is None\n    assert models.get_user_by_id(ambassador.id).active is False\n\n\ndef test_deactivating_a_staff_member_leaves_their_drafts_untouched(client):\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    leaving_staff = models.create_user(\n        email=\"leaving-staff@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=\"admin\", display_name=\"Leaving Staff\",\n    )\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    draft = models.create_post(program.id, \"Ongoing Work\", \"body\", \"housing\", leaving_staff.id)\n\n    models.deactivate_user(leaving_staff.id)\n\n    kept = models.get_post_by_id(draft.id)\n    assert kept test_deactivation_leaves_pending_and_published_posts_alone(client, role):\n    admin = models.get_user_by_email(\"admin@example.test\")\n    author = models.create_user(\n        email=f\"author-{role}@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=role, display_name=\"Author\", active=True,\n    )\n    program = _seed_program(admin.id)\n    pending = models.create_post(program.id, \"Pending Post\", \"body\", \"housing\", author.id)\n    models.set_post_status(pending.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n    published = models.create_post(program.id, \"Published Post\", \"body\", \"housing\", author.id)\n    models.set_post_status(published.id, from_status=\"draft\", to_status=\"pending\")\n    models.set_post_status(published.id, from_status=\"pending\", to_status=\"published\")\n\n    models.deactivate_user(author.id)\n\n    assert models.get_post_by_id(pending.id).status == \"pending\"\n    published_after = models.get_post_by_id(published.id)\n    assert published_after.status == \"published\"\n    assert published_after.author_id == author.id\n\n\ndef test_set_user_role_changes_an_existing_users_role(client):\n    ambassador = models.create_user(\n        email=\"promote-me@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Promote Me\",\n    )\n    updated = models.set_user_role(ambassador.id, \"admin\")\n    assert updated.role == \"admin\"\n    assert models.get_user_by_id(ambassador.id).role == test_reactivate_user_restores_active_flag(client):\n    ambassador = models.create_user(\n        email=\"back-again@example.test\", password=\"pw\",\n        role=\"editor\", display_name=\"Back test_staff_creates_a_user_and_assigns_a_role(client_as):\n    admin_c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = admin_c.get(\"/admin/accounts/new\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n    token = assert response.status_code == 303\n    created = models.get_user_by_email(\"new-ambassador@example.test\")\n    assert created is not None\n    assert created.role == \"editor\"\n    assert admin_c.post(\n        f\"/admin/accounts/{target.id}/deactivate\",\n        data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False,\n    )\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert models.get_user_by_id(target.id).active is False\n\n    list_page = admin_c.get(\"/admin/accounts\")\n    token = _csrf_token_from(list_page.text)\n    response = admin_c.post(\n
